'''Anakaret''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At a pirate clearinghouse, she was forced to participate in a deadly game at the behest of [[Aral tukor Viest]]. Her life was saved during the game by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. As a result, Anakaret felt she owed a debt to Organa, and hence helped her and her comrades escape the clearinghouse by broadcasting a fake [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] transmission.
